title: SiteCrawled
description: The page has been fetched and measured in a headless browser. Checks are computed next; when pageStatus is not ok the analysis ends with SiteAnalysisFailed.

pageStatus.description: ok: page loaded; error: unreachable or HTTP error; skipped: excluded by the site's robots.txt.

httpStatus.description: Final HTTP status; 0 when no response was received.

redirects.description: Number of redirects followed before the final response.
